commits.message: Removed broken image from modinfo.json (used by imya as a readme)
Fixed banner for [Ornamental] Ornamental Chimneys
Update readme.md
Update readme.md
Uploaded [Ornamental] Ornamental Chimneys
Initial commit
Update License
Added disclaimer that the project is not affiliated with Ubisoft to the readme
Update readme.md
Update readme.md
Updated readme

Tons of final fixes

Added readme
Added atlas_mode, no_texture_blacklist, flat_overwrites_steep and display_licenses to the CLI params and implemented their functionality
Added warning if unknown CLI arguments are passed
Updated the comment in snowgenerator.cpp explaining the algorithm
Improved comments & Cleaned up commented out code
Display licenses by passing --licenses as CLI arg
Improved error handling
Save isometric renderings as 1600x1600 .jpg files
Added statistics on files being skipped because they don't have textures to generate snow for
Removed unused code
Clear the snowmaps with glClear instead of using a separate shader program
Added --steep_overwrites_flat CLI arg to define whether fragments used by different parts of the geometry should generate more or less snow
Improve skipping .cfg materials, especially if they use default textures
Adapt the size of the metallic texture outputed to the one of the corresponding diffuse texture -> Output may have lower resolution (as in production/food_08)
Code beautifications, regarding syntax/formatting, comments, removal of unused methods and commented out code, better readability
Fixed .rdm path in the .cfg lacking the _lod0 indication leading to the file not being found (as in production/heavy_02)
Remove whitespaces at the end of the texture path specified in the .cfg (closing tag on next line, as in jje1000/[Gameplay] Bourse/.../bourse.cfg)
Redid the logic to find where to load a texture from in order to add atlas mode
Refactored double code in the texture saving and added saving as .jpg function
Flip the rendering vertically both in the exported image and on screen

And:
Overhauled the core snow generation shader, improving visual quality, clarity and performance
Show licenses of open source projects with CLI arg --licenses flag
Add CLI option to save the isometric renderings as png files
Use "Repeat" texture wrap method in vertexshader
Save snowmap to depthbuffer + fix material in cfg/rdm mismatch

Final improvements

- Generate snow for a single .cfg file (passing it as CLI parameter)
- Minor improvements to console output
- Filename of currently processed .cfg as window title
- Skip files that do not have textures to generate snow for -> improved speed a lot
- Added --noprompt CLI flag (when set, do not wait for user input before closing the window)
- Changed isometric rendering background color

Fix snow being generated on brick walls

Doesn't any longer generate snow where the geometry is steep (/vertical), but the normal map makes the fragment appear to be inclined almost horizontally - which is the case on the upper edge of bricks

Various improvements (see Description)

- Loading of default textures improved
- Isometric renderings are now rendered with snow
- Moved snowed version of textures to Texture class
- Isometric renderings are now scaled to fit the models' size
- ground textures are no longer loaded&saved
-
- Code beautification
Fixed materials being mixed up + only output 1 line per texture saved
Created "Texture" class

Improved isometric rendering + more

enabled depth testing + generally improved isometric renderings
added short versions of CLI parameters
started todo.txt list
Added isometric rendering
Moved from wstring to std::filesystem::path
MIT license (copyright einmeterhecht)
Moved CLI option parser to seperate class

 -i -o --save_png --only_png --no_dds
